title: Spartix Task Packet Schema
description: Defines the structure of a Task Packet used by TBEP and CO before any specialist agent begins execution. Every field is documented with its purpose and constraints.

packetId.description: Unique task packet identifier. Format: TP-YYYY-NNN where YYYY is the year and NNN is a sequential number.

createdBy.description: The agent that created this packet. Must always be TBEP.

approvedBy.description: The agent that approved this packet for assignment. Must always be CO.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when TBEP created this packet.

approvedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when CO approved this packet for assignment.

priority.description: Task priority level determining execution urgency.

assignment.description: Identifies which specialist agent is assigned and why.

agentName.description: Full role name of the assigned agent.

agentCode.description: Short code identifier of the assigned agent.

agentCategory.description: Category folder the agent belongs to.

agentArabicName.description: The Arabic human name of the assigned agent.

selectionRationale.description: Explanation of why this agent was selected over alternatives. Shown in the user-visible workflow feed.

description.description: Detailed description of what must be accomplished. Must be unambiguous.

businessContext.description: Why this task matters to the project and business objectives.

dependencies.description: List of external dependencies that must be satisfied.

predecessorTasks.description: List of task packet IDs that must be completed before this task.

scope.description: Defines the boundaries of work — what to do and what NOT to do.

inScope.description: Explicit list of work items the specialist MUST do.

outOfScope.description: Explicit list of work items the specialist MUST NOT do. Prevents scope creep.

boundaries.description: Additional narrative describing the responsibility boundaries.

inputs.description: Everything the specialist needs to begin work.

requiredInputs.description: List of inputs the specialist needs. Must all be available before execution starts.

referenceMaterials.description: Links to wiki pages, predecessor outputs, or documentation.

contextFromPreviousTasks.description: Summary of relevant outputs from predecessor tasks.

primaryDeliverables.description: List of deliverables that must be produced.

outputFormat.description: Expected format for each deliverable (e.g., Markdown, JSON, source code, diagram).

qualityStandards.description: Minimum quality requirements the deliverables must meet.

testingRequirements.description: How the output will be validated.

testCriteria.description: What aspects of the output will be tested.

acceptanceThresholds.description: Minimum pass criteria (e.g., 80% coverage, zero critical findings).

reviewRequirements.description: Who reviews the output and what they evaluate.

reviewAgent.description: Name and code of the review-only specialist who will evaluate the output.

reviewGate.description: If true, the task cannot be marked complete until review passes.

completionCriteria.description: Explicit conditions that define when the task is done.

doneWhen.description: List of conditions that must ALL be true for the task to be considered complete.

verificationMethod.description: How completion will be verified (e.g., automated tests, manual review, checklist).

returnRequirements.description: What the completion report must contain.

completionReportFormat.description: Expected format of the completion report.

requiredSections.description: Mandatory sections in the completion report.

blockerReporting.description: How blockers must be reported (severity, impact, recommended resolution).

governance.description: Governance constraints the specialist must obey during execution.

mandatoryHooks.description: List of hooks that MUST be obeyed. Cannot be skipped.

approvedSkills.description: List of skills the specialist MAY use. Using unapproved skills is forbidden.

activeRules.description: List of active rules from the rule context that apply to this task.

constraints.description: Additional constraints from the active rule context.
